plain.li: [former] I still sit in the same place at the long table, and nobody here has asked me to move.
[former] Some evenings I walk through the old rooms and remember who slept where in {OLDCOLONY}'s days.
[former] The newer people here ask what {OLDCOLONY} was like, and I tell them it was much the same, only louder.
[former] I think of the colony's meetings often, and of how long we used to argue over small things.
[former] I find I run {TOWN} much the way the council ran {OLDCOLONY}, and I cannot tell whether that is good sense or habit.
[former] Tell the council I still wait for a vote before I decide anything, and that it drives people here to distraction.
[former,years] It is {YEARSSINCE} since the hand-over, and I still use the names we had for things in {OLDCOLONY}.
[former,years] {YEARSSINCE} now. I counted the days after the hand-over for a while, and then one day I found I had stopped.
[former,years] {YEARSSINCE} on, the newer faces at {TOWN} know {OLDCOLONY} only from what those of us who stayed tell them.
[former,!years] It is not a year since we handed {OLDCOLONY} over, and the place still feels as if it is waiting for the rest of you to come in.
[former,!years] We are still learning to run {TOWN} on our own. Every choice feels like one the council ought to be making.
[former,tribal] When the fire burns low at night, I still look round for the faces that went with you.
[former,tribal] The stories told at our fire have your names in them now, and the young hunters ask for those ones most.
[former,medieval] On market days I still look for the colony's people among the stalls.
[former,medieval] The old charter's seal sits on my table, and I use it more than I ever thought I would.
[former,industrial] I keep the colony's old ledgers in the office, and open them whenever I need to know how something was done.
[former,industrial] The township still works to the colony's old shifts, and nobody here has found a reason to change them.
[former,spacer] The administration's logs still carry {OLDCOLONY}'s designation at the head of every entry. I see no reason to change it.
[former,spacer] I review the colony's old records most evenings. There is a decision in there for nearly everything.
[new] I never knew {OLDCOLONY} as it was, but I work at its tables and sleep under its roofs, and I am grateful for both.
[new] I was not one of {OLDCOLONY}'s people, and I am told often enough what the colony would have done. I listen, mostly.
[new] I lead {TOWN} now, and I mean to keep the friendship {OLDCOLONY} left between us.
[new] Your people built well. We have kept it standing, and added to it a little where we had to.
[new] It is strange to lead a town built for someone else, but the walls fit us well enough.
[new] Forgive me if I use the wrong names for things. I learned them all after the colony left.
[new,years] I have led {TOWN} a while now, and still the first thing anyone asks a traveler is whether they came by way of {COLONY}.
[asks,!tribal] {ASKER} thinks of {KIN} often and wanted it written down, so here it is.
[asks] {ASKER} wants {KIN} to know that the road between us runs both ways.
[asks] {ASKER} asked me to put in a word for {KIN}: come and see us when you can.
[asks,tribal] {ASKER} sends {KIN} a greeting in the old words, the ones the band used, and hopes {KIN} still knows them.
[asks,former] {ASKER} and I both think of {KIN} when we sit down to eat. Tell {KIN} that, from the two of us.
[asks,!tribal] {ASKER} will want an answer for {KIN}, so send one back with yours if you can.
[struggling,former] I have never been so careful with the stores, not even in {OLDCOLONY}'s leanest days.
[struggling] There is less on every plate than there was, and nobody here pretends otherwise.
[struggling] I would not say this to anyone else, but {TOWN} is in a bad way.
[struggling,former] I keep wondering what the colony's council would do with {TOWN} as it is now, and I do not like my answers.
[struggling] We have let the outer fields go to grass. There are not the hands to work them.
[poor] It has been a thin season, and the stores are lower than I would like going into the next.
[poor,former] We are managing, if only just, the way {OLDCOLONY} managed in its first days.
[poor] Nobody here is starving, but nobody is putting on weight either.
[steady] Nothing much to tell. The roofs hold, the stores are full enough, and the arguments are the usual ones.
[steady] A quiet season at {TOWN}, which is the best kind.
[steady,former] Life here is dull beside the colony's, and I mean that as good news.
[steady] The town is much as you left it, with a little more wear on the doorframes.
[thriving] We have more mouths than we had and enough to feed them, which is the right way round.
[thriving] Traders who used to pass {TOWN} by stop here now, and tell us we are a busy place.
[thriving,former] {OLDCOLONY} would hardly know itself, with all the coming and going.
[flourishing] {TOWN} has never done so well, and I wanted the colony to hear it from us first.
[flourishing,new] I am told {OLDCOLONY} was a good place. I hope you will think {TOWN} a better one, if you come to see it.
[flourishing] We are building again, and for once it is because we need the room.
[deed:townDefended] People here still speak of the day the colony's fighters stood on our walls.
[deed:townDefended,former] When the raiders came, the colony came too. I have not forgotten it, and I will not.
[deed:refused] When we called on the colony, the answer was no. I will not pretend that has been forgotten here.
[deed:refused,former] I know the colony had its reasons for turning us down, but some here took it hard.
[deed:hardship] We remember who stood by us when the year was hard, and we say so at supper.
[deed:gift] The colony's gift is still talked about. People here do not forget a kindness.
[deed:traded] Your traders have dealt fairly with us, and that is noticed here.
[deed:mission] The colony kept its word to us, and people here count that for a great deal.
[deed:bad] Some in {TOWN} speak less warmly of the colony than they used to. I will not pretend otherwise.
[their:friend] {FRIEND} is well thought of here. Give {FRIEND} our greetings.
[tie:pact:trade] The trade pact holds, and our traders know the road to {COLONY} well by now.
[tie:pact:defence] The pact stands. If the colony calls, {TOWN} will come.
[town:lately:colony:formerDied] We lost one of the colony's own here not long ago. I thought you should hear it from me as well.
[town:lately:colony:homecoming] One of ours went home to the colony lately, and {TOWN} feels the gap.
[town:lately:colony:homecoming,former] One of us went home to the colony not long ago, and I find I envy them a little.
[region:newtown:theirs] Some of our people have gone to settle {NEWTOWN}, and {TOWN} is quieter for it.
Remember us to anyone at {COLONY} who still asks after {TOWN}.
If the colony is ever short of something we have, ask, and we will see what can be spared.
We hear news of {COLONY} from every traveler who passes, and we are always glad of it.
[spacer] Reply on this channel when it suits you. We keep it open.
[!tribal] There is not much more to say, so I will close here and send this on its way.
[takeback,warm] Your letter was read out at supper, and nobody argued. Come home.
[takeback,warm] We kept the rooms as you left them, more or less. They are yours again.
[takeback,warm,theirLowtech] The elders sat with it a long while, and the answer is yes. Come back to your fire.
[takeback,warm,theirHightech] The vote was not close. Send word when your people are on their way.
[takeback,warm,letter] Yes, and gladly. I have kept this short so that it reaches you sooner.
[takeback,cordial] It is right that it goes back to the people who built it. We agree.
[takeback,cordial,theirLowtech] Our fire was lit from yours. It can burn under your roof again.
[takeback,cordial,call] We have talked it over, and the answer is yes. The place is ready when you are.
[takeback,cool] We agree, though not everyone here is happy about it.
[takeback,cool,theirLowtech] The elders say yes. Some of the young ones say otherwise, but the elders speak for the hearth.
[takeback,cool,call] Fine. We cannot keep it going alone, and you know it.
[takeback,refusal] We are grateful for what the colony gave us, and that is exactly why we mean to keep it.
[takeback,refusal,theirLowtech] The hearth is ours now. Come and sit at it as guests whenever you like.
[takeback,refusal,theirHightech] It was put to a vote, and it was not close. {TOWN} stays as it is.
[takeback,refusal,letter] I am sorry to send your letter back with a no, but the answer is no.
[takeback,refusal,call] Not now, and I think not ever. We have made it our own.
[welcome] Put your pack down, you're home now.
[welcome] We talked about you every time someone came up the road.
[welcome] Let me look at you properly.
[welcome] There's a lot to tell you, but eat something first.
[welcome] You look tired, and you look well, both at once.
[welcome,rain] Get in out of the rain, and then tell me everything.
[welcome,snow] You walked all that way in the snow, come and get warm.
[welcome,night] You came in late, but you came.
[welcome,old] I hoped I'd live to see you come home.
[welcome,child] Are you staying with us now?
[welcome,lowtech] Come and sit down, there's room on the bench.
[back] I'm home, wherever the colony is.
[back] The town was good to me, but this is where I belong.
[back] I always meant to come back.
[back] Tell me everything I missed.
[back] I'm not going anywhere for a while.
[back] I've thought about this moment the whole way here.
[back,rain] I'm soaked through, and I don't care at all.
[back,winter] The cold kept me walking faster.
[back,old] I wasn't sure these legs would get me here.
[back,lowtech] The path was longer than I remembered, or I'm slower.
[back,highmood] I can't stop smiling, so don't ask me to.

warm.li: [welcome] I missed you more than I let anyone see.
[back] Seeing you is worth every step of the road.

blunt.li: [back] I'm back, so where do I sleep?

gloomy.li: [welcome] I was afraid you'd never come.
[back] I hope it isn't too late to come home.

cold.li: [back] I've returned, and I mean to stay.
